facts.fact: Rian 独自回圣殿：想用矛（若真是 fulcrum）治疗阶井——怕 pinfeathers 复发没叫 Nikolas；自滴几滴血试验阶井余绪。
facts.anchor: Rian Cyr sat in the house of the god he’d renounced

facts.fact: 滴血引声：Phos 之声应答「There you are」——被附身岁月的记忆回灌（eaten of my own flesh and blood, and it was not so bad）。
facts.anchor: I have already eaten of my own flesh and blood,

facts.fact: 卫兵被屠：五道光裂成五翼战士（金眼）；领头的持金属圆筒三发洞穿三卫兵心脏（圆形灼孔无声倒地）——「You're not on our lord's list...But He will have use of you」——她说的正是父亲坚持兄弟俩学的 Solarian 官话。
Rian 觉醒宣言：冰封的恐慌碎裂——「I will never be his puppet again」——Lucent 缠腕、lightspeed 一跨消失。
facts.anchor: “I will never,” he growled, “be his puppet again.”

facts.fact: 别墅遇袭：肩胛刺痛+巨响——门厅塌毁；翼战士（苍白长发、多圈耳环、猫眼）喊「Child of the Daystar...Forfeit yourself to Lord Phosand there will be no need for conflict」——唇角却是预备扑咬的弧度。
闪回叠影：单次心跳里翻过整本暴力画册——被别针钉住名字的他；「A kicked pet will slink into the corner...A wilder animal will bite back」——Nikolas 翼张吼出扑杀。
facts.anchor: A kicked pet will slink into the corner and wonder what it’s done wrong.

facts.fact: 战士识破矛：「Your weapon...It holds the Daystar's feathers」——他自己颈上是重复 glyph 项圈：「I, too, have been gifted with the ashes of His feathers」——盯着空眼窝劝「Let Him burn them into you...Let Him heal you」。

反杀：PTSD 递进到 WON'T——pinfeathers 如针刺破皮；他扑上撕扯战士的翼（sickening wrench）+拳头连击（no more×3）——「I won't let him hurt me ever again」——战士挣脱反扑，「Like that day and like that man, Nikolas did not hesitate」——全力挥矛劈向圣环之颈（章末悬停）。
